sentences.text: The bank’s policy says processing fee and documentation charges for loans are recovered as applicable at the time of sanction.
The gold-loan document says gold loans are governed by the bank’s Gold Loan Operational Guidelines, but it does not state a gold-loan processing-fee amount in the evidence provided.
The policy says the schedule of service charges approved by the Board shall be displayed at all branches and on the bank’s website.
I could not find a gold-loan-specific processing-fee figure in the provided evidence, so the exact amount remains missing.

missing.searched: Searched the bank’s gold-loan guidance, loan policy, and fee schedule evidence for a gold-loan-specific processing-fee amount.
